Future memory architectures will require advances in device design, materials and process technology to meet growing performance and capacity requirements. The expanded collaboration is designed to align future device requirements more closely with materials innovation. It combines Entegris’ capabilities in materials science, computational modeling, simulation and semiconductor process solutions with Kioxia’s expertise in memory technology and process integration.
